zh.text: 服务端版本清单请求带缓存破坏参数，修复 Cloudflare 边缘缓存把旧 index.json 钉死、导致 R2 更新后启动器仍显示旧版本列表的问题。
服务端与客户端种子下载按钮新增「有新下载」脉冲提示：出现更新版本时按钮脉冲，用户查看一次后脉冲取消，仅再次出现新版本时重新提示。
新增客户端种子清单 down/client.json 与 download:clientIndex 通道，客户端种子下载与服务端分开维护，独立检测新版本。
启动前预检文案由「版本」改为「基线」，避免与服务端/模组版本号混淆，措辞更准确。

en.text: Server version index requests now carry a cache-busting parameter, fixing stale version lists caused by Cloudflare's edge cache pinning the old index.json after the R2 manifest was updated.
Server and client seed download buttons now pulse to signal a new download is available; the pulse clears after the user views it and reappears only when a newer version appears.
Added a separate client seed manifest (down/client.json) and a download:clientIndex channel, so client seed downloads are maintained independently of the server and detect new versions on their own.
Pre-launch preflight wording changed from "version" to "baseline" to avoid confusion with server/mod version numbers.
